summaryVariants.serviceDesk: IT support and infrastructure professional with New Zealand experience providing remote, on-site and multi-client technical support. Hands-on with Windows Server, Microsoft 365, Azure AD/Entra ID, user access, networking, VPNs, cloud services and ticket escalation. Known for clear customer communication, careful documentation, practical troubleshooting and automation with Python, Bash and PowerShell. Brings additional Linux, Azure, AWS, monitoring and hardware support experience, with full New Zealand work rights through August 2027.
summaryVariants.systems: Systems and infrastructure professional experienced in technical support, systems administration, troubleshooting and documented service improvement across education, enterprise and cloud environments. Hands-on with Windows and Linux systems, Microsoft 365, Azure AD/Entra ID, Azure, AWS, networking, databases, monitoring and automation. Comfortable translating user needs into trackable technical work, managing competing priorities and collaborating with clients and engineering teams. Holds a Master of Applied Technologies and New Zealand work rights through August 2027.
summaryVariants.technicalSupport: Technical support and infrastructure professional with experience resolving user, system, network, cloud and hosting issues through remote, on-site, ticket, chat, email and customer-facing channels. Combines clear communication and methodical troubleshooting with hands-on knowledge of Windows, Linux, Microsoft 365, Azure AD/Entra ID, networking, cPanel/WHM, cloud platforms and hardware. Experienced in escalation, root-cause investigation, knowledge documentation and continuous learning, with New Zealand work rights through August 2027.
summaryVariants.devops: Linux and cloud infrastructure professional experienced in production support, server administration, automation and incident response across Azure and AWS. Hands-on with Ubuntu, CentOS/RHEL, Terraform, Ansible, Python, Bash, PowerShell, CI/CD, NGINX, PostgreSQL, Zabbix, Prometheus and Grafana. Combines practical systems troubleshooting with user support, documentation and on-call experience. Holds New Zealand work rights through August 2027.
